description: This HTML file defines the front-end UI for a database viewer application, including styles, layout, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic interaction with backend API endpoints to browse and display database data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database item in the sidebar and loads its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables within a selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a selected table in the main view.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table with data fetched from backend.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, long text, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.

search-terms: embedded JavaScript for dynamic data display
UI layout with sidebar and content area
